messages:
jess: heads-up: us-east-1 GPU cluster reporting repeated 'GPU bus reset' + ECC correctable spikes, several k8s pods OOM/killed. Noticing ~12% GPU capacity drop in us-east-1-gpu-pool. Need drain & failover plan. Logs below.

ops-bot: :warning: [alert] 2026-03-18T02:14:09Z - node-gpu-143 bus reset x3; kernel triggered restart

jess: logs:
```
Mar 18 02:13:58 node-gpu-143 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 13, pid=1024 ... GPU bus reset
Mar 18 02:14:01 node-gpu-201 kernel: GPU ECC correctable count increased to 1.2k
Mar 18 02:16:22 kubelet[1234]: Evicting pod inference-svc-7fd4 due to OOM on /device/gpu0
```

infra-oncall: ok, moving to drain node-gpu-143, node-gpu-148, node-gpu-201. anyone seeing this outside us-east?

mike: confirmed similar on node-gpu-148. kube-proxy healthchecks flapping. I'll start drains and cordon. issuing commands:
```
kubectl drain node-gpu-143 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
kubectl cordon node-gpu-148
```

sophia: propose shifting 20% of inference traffic from us-east-1 to eu-west-1 for next 2h. We have spare dedicated capacity there. That keeps latency SLOs while we replace nodes. Cost hit ~+3% for the hour.

anita: please coordinate with Dedicated (cc @dedicated) — we may need to pull reserved GPUs if eu-west fills up. Also open HW RMA tickets with vendor (NVIDIA) for affected cards.

leo: I can swap replacement blades in rack-7 tonight. ETA ~12h for hands-on swap + reimage. If we can avoid full rebuild we can keep PVs attached. I'll log serials to case #R-3421.

mike: draining now. small note: autoscaler is set to not scale down during recoveries; recommend temporary relax to allow pods to move. patching cluster-autoscaler config (will add 5m cooldown).

ops-bot: [action] drains initiated for node-gpu-143, node-gpu-148, node-gpu-201 by mike at 2026-03-18T02:20:12Z

jess: can someone flip routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for models heavy on 8k tokens? set fallback on mismatch to rtx-4x-small so clients don't get hard errors.

sophia: done — traffic shift 20% started via feature-flag 'region-failover-us-east->eu-west', ttl 30m. monitoring p99 latency and error-rate.

anita: vendor support ticket opened: Case #NV-2026-881. RMA ETA 48-72h for replacement cards. I've attached kernel logs.

infra-oncall: quick update: after drains, usable GPU capacity in us-east recovered to ~92% within 30m. We're keeping canary routing for 1h then ramp back slowly. Creating incident doc for follow-up.

jess: thx all. postmortem owners: mike (drain ops), sophia (routing/traffic), anita (vendor + capacity). I'll kick off the incident doc and link logs.

leo: left a note on the rack: serials recorded and spare blades staged. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: [closed] incident snapshot saved to /incidents/2026-03-18-gpu-busreset.json
